result.title: DeciForm: Incorporating Task Structure into Decision Models
result.summary: Decision models unify candidate selection, Boolean judgment, and numerical scoring within a single model. Their answer spaces nevertheless carry different structures: classification candidates form an unordered set, while numerical scores have an intrinsic order and distance. We introduce Deciform, which incorporates these distinctions into computation and supervision. Candidate-free queries and isolated candidate branches support consistent classification under reordering. A log--spherical objective trains candidate probabilities, while a decimal-prefix readout combines individual-value and interval-weighted cumulative supervision for numerical scoring. Shared adapters, task-private residuals, and output-channel gains support joint adaptation. On a shared 15,000-request test set, Deciform improves all three decision metrics on Qwen and ModernBERT; source-normalized errors support the Score gains across the data mixture. Canonicalized joint encoding also eliminates tested order flips, while isolation further improves prediction metrics. Separate objective studies and main-configuration ablations examine the classification and numerical components. After one epoch of MIND-small adaptation, Deciform improves multi-positive news ranking on both backbones. These results support matching encoding and supervision to answer-space structure within a unified decision interface.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 DeciForm，在单一决策模型内统一候选选择、布尔判断与数值打分，并按答案空间结构设计计算与监督：候选无关查询与隔离候选分支保证分类对重排序一致，log-spherical 目标与十进制前缀读出分别用于概率与数值评分。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按答案空间结构定制读出与监督」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何映射到有序／无序判断输出、以及验证头与评分头的监督设计提供可核查线索，但原文不涉及视觉推理。
